## Email Us

Got a question about one of our outings, or want to share a sighting of a cool bird? The best way to get in
touch is by sending an email to [contact@westmannaturalists.ca](mailto:contact@westmannaturalists.ca).
We check our inbox semi-regularly!

You may see our Gmail address on older posts or accounts (such as eBird). While it is no longer our
main inbox, we are still able to receive emails at that address and do check it periodically.

## Social Media

Give us a follow! Photos from our outings are posted to
[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/westmannaturalists) and [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/westmannaturalists).

You can also find some of our videos posted to
[YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@westmannaturalists) and [Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/westmannaturalists).
